subject.title: feat: nameplate attention --wait blocks until the human acknowledges

question: Which stable terminal outcome should `nameplate dismiss` produce for an active `attention --wait` request?
rationale: The recovery command landed after the PR base, and supporting it requires either adding a public outcome and exit status or intentionally mapping dismissal to an existing non-success result.

options.title: Add dismissed outcome
options.body: Emit a distinct acknowledgment and documented exit status when manual recovery closes an active request.

options.title: Map dismissal to exit 4
options.body: Release the waiter promptly but group manual dismissal with supersession as a documented non-success completion.

options.title: Leave waiter until timeout
options.body: Keep UI recovery independent even though the correlated process remains blocked after the card disappears.

recommendation.title: Add dismissed outcome
recommendation.body: Emit a distinct acknowledgment and documented exit status when manual recovery closes an active request.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced both the attention lifecycle and current manual-dismiss recovery behavior.
